proof.text: Use the universal structure-pushforward isomorphism to obtain connected fibres. The locally constant rank of E is constant on each fibre; openness of the flat finite-presentation morphism and closedness of the proper morphism give open-and-closed strata S_r on whose inverse images E has rank r. Fix this rank before constructing either direct-image locus.

On each S_r, proper flat cohomology and base change give perfect nonnegative direct-image complexes for E and its dual. Construct their lowest-cohomology rank-r loci, both with the same fixed rank r, and take their fibre product. The pulled-back E has rank r under every further base change by construction, so this immersion represents all three clauses of the corrected core condition.

Conversely the third clause fixes the bundle rank r locally, and the two universal direct-image clauses give local factorizations through the two rank-r loci. Uniqueness for immersions glues these maps. Assemble the loci over the disjoint open-and-closed base strata; empty test schemes cause no exception.
